title: Parameter - Textarea Attribute Value
description: The parameter is used as an attribute value, i.e. <textarea attribute=%q>.

Parameter - Textarea Attribute Value

The q parameter is echoed inside an attribute of a <textarea> element.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected textarea with attribute:
objectives: Escape the attribute quotes on the <textarea> element.
Inject event handler attributes or close the opening tag.
hints: Break out with double quotes: " autofocus onfocus="alert(1).
